question: To whom must transmission of this ritual knowledge be refused?
premises: It must not be given to a non-devotee
It must not be given to one who hates gods and brāhmaṇas
inference: The ritual knowledge is restricted from non-devotees and those hostile to gods and brāhmaṇas.
plain_english: It must not be given to one without devotion, nor to one who hates gods and brāhmaṇas.
